name: multiply per-feature likelihoods with a class prior
mechanism: estimate for each class the frequency of each feature value, and classify a new item to the class maximising the prior times the product of its features' likelihoods, as if features were independent given the class

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Naive Bayes classifier' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: a family of probabilistic classifiers based on Bayes' theorem
